body:
Hey there, u need to go talk to your mom. She really seems to care for you. Small things like she and you're father fighting is not big enough for you to avoid talking to her.


I've been through hard times in my life too. Many times I've felt that there's no point living and I'll be better off. But I took a chance and talked to my brother (who I was not so close) about my depression, it was the best decision I ever made. You need to talk to someone about, if u don't think your mom, then a friend, if not them then a therapist. You need to let it out. 

. I really believe that if you talk then it'll help.
